title: resource deleted
description: A resource was removed. A board open on the design drops it without reloading the whole design.

source.description: /designer/<design>: the event comes from e-designer and names the design it serves, so a reader listening to many products knows which design changed (ADR-E2).

data.description: Which resource went, from which file, and the file's hash before.

file.description: The file that held the resource, relative to the design.

kind.description: The resource's kind, such as Block. An id is unique only within a kind, so kind and id together name the resource.

id.description: The resource's id; read together with kind.
